Created the skill. This question was CORRECT, and the generalizable insight worth preserving is the Fisher Ideal symmetric growth rate formula (g = ln(V_end/V_start)) plus two traps that future agents would otherwise re-derive:

1. **Ordering**: earlier date = start/base, later date = end, regardless of naming order in the prose. A falling series must give a negative result — good sign check.
2. **"as of reported values on the end of the FY"** pins which single bulletin to read (Sept/Oct 1982 for FY1982), where both Aug 1982 and Aug 1981 appear in the same recent-months yield table.

Saved as the new skill `officeqa-fisher-ideal-symmetric-growth`. No memory update needed — this fits cleanly alongside the existing growth-metric skill family (CAGR, arc elasticity, geometric mean) and memory is already near capacity.
